title: Street Fighter III: New Generation
note: Capcom CPS3 fighting game: health, health_p2, time, credits, power, power_p2, 11 characters (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cps_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: CPS3 main RAM from 0x2000000 (512 KB), bytes reversed within 32-bit words

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0xA0 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL1)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0xA0 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL2)

power.note: super gauge of player 1 in %, full = 0xA0 (FBNeo cheat database)

power_p2.note: super gauge of player 2 in %, full = 0xA0 (FBNeo cheat database)

_p1_chr.note: player 1 character, first byte (FBNeo cheat database, Select Character PL1)

_p1_chr2.note: player 1 character, second byte (FBNeo cheat database, Select Character PL1)

_p2_chr.note: player 2 or computer character, first byte (FBNeo cheat database, Select Character PL2)

_p2_chr2.note: player 2 or computer character, second byte (FBNeo cheat database, Select Character PL2)

backdrop.note: stage backdrop, picks the HD theme in hd.stages (FBNeo cheat database, Select Permanent Background)

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)

hd.note: HD theme and place shown for each backdrop value (index = value), made by tools/cps_games.py from the stages of the cheat database, see README, HD themes
